lesson.title: Lock down the server
lesson.goal: GuestPC can read the FileServer page. Allow the office subnet 10.10.0.0/25 and block everyone else with ufw.

step.text: Open http://10.10.0.2/ from GuestPC. The page loads, which is the problem.
On FileServer open Terminal and run sudo ufw enable.
Set the incoming policy to deny: sudo ufw default deny incoming.
Allow the office subnet: sudo ufw allow from 10.10.0.0/25.
Try both computers: OfficePC still opens the page, GuestPC is refused.

check.label: GuestPC is refused by the server firewall
